description: Captured from `node extension/server.mjs` on a temp DB (LLMIDE_DB_PATH in TMPDIR, LLMIDE_ENGINE_PREWARM=0), replayed over HTTP and seeded through the API. No external call is made: The task was dispatched to a provider with no poller in this build (provider "capture"), so the poll records an unknown state without any network call. The creds are a placeholder; they are not used for this provider.
